title: 新的工作单元
description: 新的工作单元：虚拟机让基础设施可编程，容器让应用可移植，Kubernetes workload 让分布式系统可运营，Agent 则让软件能够推理并采取行动。
text:
A New Unit of Work

 Every major computing shift creates a new unit of work.

            Era         Primary Abstraction             What It Changed

       Virtualization    Virtual Machine      Infrastructure became programmable.

       Cloud Native         Container            Applications became portable.

       Kubernetes           Workload          Distributed systems became operable.

         AI Native            Agent           Software can reason and take action.


 “Containers are still the execution unit.
  Agents are becoming a new unit of autonomous work.”

title: 容器与 Kubernetes 的贡献
description: 容器与 Kubernetes 的贡献：打包、环境一致性、隔离、声明式配置和控制器调谐形成“构建一次、到处运行”的基础。
text:
What Containers and
Kubernetes Solved
● Containers changed how we package software.
   Portable runtimes / Consistent environments / Resource isolation / Repeatable deployment /
   Declarative configuration

   Build once → Run anywhere


● Kubernetes changed how we operate software.
   Desired State
         ↓
   Declarative APIs
         ↓
   Controllers reconcile reality
         ↓
   Scalable, resilient, observable workloads

title: Agent 的差异
description: Agent 的差异：Agent 以目标驱动决策，不只是带 LLM 的请求响应服务；它可能有状态、长期运行、非确定性、工具连接和被委派权限。
text:
Agents Are Different

● An agent is not just a service with an LLM inside.
   A traditional service follows a predictable request-response flow.
   An agent receives a goal and decides how to act.


● An agent can be
   Stateful / Long-running / Non-deterministic / Tool-connected / Delegated with authority




 “An agent does not only respond. An agent can act.”

title: 健康不等于安全
description: 健康不等于安全：Pod、API、延迟和工具调用都正常，Agent 仍可能给出错误客户结果；运行时健康不足以证明行为正确。
text:
A Healthy Runtime Can
Still Be Unsafe
● Traditional infrastructure asks: “Is the workload healthy?”
   Is the Pod running? Is the API available?
   Is latency within the SLO? Is the error rate acceptable?
   Is CPU or GPU utilization normal?


● Agent infrastructure must also ask: “Did the agent behave correctly?”
   Pod: Running        ✓
   API: 200 OK        ✓
   Latency: 800ms       ✓
   Tool Call: Successful ✓
   Customer Outcome: Wrong ✗


 “Runtime health is necessary—but not sufficient.”

title: 新的运营问题
description: 新的运营问题：需要回答 Agent 身份、授权者、可访问资源、可执行动作、决策原因、目标达成情况和人工介入时机。
text:
The New Operational Problem

 Operating autonomous software requires new answers.
     Question                            Why It Matters

     Who is this agent?                  Identity and auditability

     Who authorized it to act?           Delegation and accountability

     What can it access?                 Data and tool permissions

     What actions can it take?           Safety and policy enforcement

     Why did it make this decision?      Debugging and observability

     Did it achieve the right outcome?   Evaluation and reliability

     When should a human intervene?      Governance and approval

description: 观察决策而不只是请求：链路从用户目标、检索上下文、模型决策、工具选择和参数、工具结果延伸到最终动作、结果与反馈。
text:
Observe Decisions,
Not Just Requests
● Traditional observability follows requests.
   Request → Service → Database → Response

● Agent behavior is not static. Agent observability must follow decisions
  and actions.

   → Model Decision
   → Selected Tool
   → Tool Arguments
   → Tool Result
   → Final Action
   → Outcome and Feedback

title: 复用 Cloud Native 心智模型
description: 复用 Cloud Native 心智模型：Deployment/Service/Pod 对应 Agent runtime definition，ServiceAccount 对应身份，RBAC 对应工具授权，NetworkPolicy 对应工具边界，Admission Control 对应动作前策略检查，OpenTelemetry 对应决策/动作追踪。
text:
Cloud Native Gives Us the
Right Mental Model
 We can reuse cloud native lessons, but agents require new declarative
  boundaries.
         Cloud Native Primitive       Agent Infrastructure Equivalent

         Deployment / Service / Pod   Agent runtime configuration / definition

         ServiceAccount               Agent identity

         RBAC                         Tool and action authorization

         NetworkPolicy                Tool connectivity boundaries

         Admission Control            Policy checks before action

         OpenTelemetry                Decision and action traces

         Controller Reconciliation    Continuous evaluation and correction

description: 开放 Agent 基础设施机会：沿用开放、声明式、可组合的 Cloud Native 原则，建设身份、委派、工具访问、策略、可观测性、评估和治理等通用原语。
text:
The Opportunity: Open Agent
Infrastructure
● Cloud native succeeded because its primitives were open, declarative,
  and composable.

● Build open, composable primitives for fast-moving agent ecosystem:
   Agent identity
   Delegation
   Tool access
   Policy enforcement
   Observability
   Evaluation
   Governance

Closing

 Containers made software portable.
 Kubernetes made software operable.
 Agent infrastructure must make autonomous software trustworthy.

 “Operate agents as first-class cloud native workloads.”

description: AllGather 改造：source/destination 先注册为 window；collective 完成后、stream 安全点再注销。
text:
Register symmetric memory into a window
The collective stays an AllGather; the operands become registered windows



Register the source and destination, run the existing AllGather, then deregister only after the stream completes



Key APIs                                                                                                                                                Effect
 ncclCommWindowRegister(comm, src, src_size, &src_win,                                                                                                      • Registration is collective: every rank supplies compatible source and
                        NCCL_WIN_COLL_SYMMETRIC);                                                                                                             destination regions
 ncclCommWindowRegister(comm, dst, dst_size, &dst_win,
                        NCCL_WIN_COLL_SYMMETRIC);                                                                                                           • ncclWindow_t is a local opaque handle; the logical offsets match
 ncclAllGather(src, dst, src_size, ncclInt8, comm, stream);                                                                                                   even when CUDA pointers differ

                                                                                                                                                              segments

After cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), deregister both windows before freeing the allocations.

text:
Layer 2: Agent Methodology


Before writing any kernel code, the agent must:


  1.   Confirm target GPU/TPU/AMD architecture — pause if ambiguous
  2.   Study local reference submodules: CUTLASS examples, Flash Attention CuTeDSL, LibTPU, and etc.
  3.   Study the closest reference kernel as "source of truth for performance"
  4.   Apply techniques in corresponding knowledge base and skills
  5.   Synthesize missing helpers if a CuTe operation only exists in C++


Core Invariants:


Never report performance without passing correctness
Build analytical IO model for every kernel
Complete working artifacts only (no stubs)

title: Accelerator 特征
description: Accelerator 特征：与 CPU 协作、异步执行、单 host 默认单类 accelerator、可扩展；CPU 本身不归为 accelerator。

title: 命名空间哲学

title: Device management
description: Device management：将 count/current/set/synchronize 等相似接口统一到 `torch.accelerator`，后端仍实现具体行为。

title: Stream management
description: Stream management：统一 current/default/new/set stream，减少业务代码中的后端判断。

title: Memory management
description: Memory management：统一 memory info、cache 与统计类接口；只统一契约，不统一 allocator 内部实现。

title: Generator/RNG
description: Generator/RNG：统一 state/seed 等常用操作，保证跨入口行为一致。

title: 通用 Stream 类
description: 通用 Stream 类：既是跨设备 API/上下文管理器，也允许后端类型继承并暴露 native handle。

title: 通用 Event 类
description: 通用 Event 类：统一 record/wait/query/synchronize 等基础语义，专有能力留给后端。

title: 通用 Graph

title: 兼容与一致
description: 兼容与一致：旧 `torch.<device>.foo` 与新 `torch.accelerator.foo` 共存，必须操作同一状态并返回一致语义。

title: KEP-5945
description: KEP-5945：远程或纯配置设备可声明跳过 kubelet prepare/unprepare，减少无意义节点操作。
text:
KEP-5945 · 节点准备
远程/纯配置 设备可以声明跳 过 kubelet 节点侧操作                                                                                                 Alpha

驱动在 ResourceSlice 上声明 skipNodeOperations；分配结果复制该决策，kubelet 不调用 prepare/unprepare。


   1 远程设备无需 节点插件                                2 普通 Claim 请求设备                           3 结果携 带跳过操作声明

 apiVersion: resource.k8s.io/v1               apiVersion: resource.k8s.io/v1            status:
 kind: ResourceSlice                          kind: ResourceClaim                         allocation:
 metadata:                                    metadata:                                     devices:
   name: remote-fpga                            name: remote-fpga                             results:
 spec:                                        spec:                                           - request: fpga
   driver: fpga.example.com                     devices:                                        driver: fpga.example.com
   pool:                                          requests:                                     pool: remote-pool
     name: remote-pool                            - name: fpga                                  device: fpga-a
     generation: 3                                  exactly:                                    skipNodeOperations:
     resourceSliceCount: 1                            deviceClassName:                          - "*"
   skipNodeOperations:                                   fpga.example.com               ---
   - "*"                                              count: 1                          # kubelet 行为
   devices:                                                                             # ✓ 不调用 NodePrepareResources
   - name: fpga-a                                                                       # ✓ 不调用 NodeUnprepareResources
     basic:                                                                             # ✓ 容器直接使用远程 endpoint
       attributes:
         fpga.example.com/endpoint:
            string: grpc://fpga-a:7443




                                                                                                                               v1.37 Alpha
  闭环结果          `*` 同时跳过 prepare/unprepare；若只声明 NodePrepareResources，必须也跳过 NodeUnprepareResources。节           DRAOptionalNodeOperations +
                点需声明支持该 feature。                                                                              NodeDeclaredFeatures（Alpha）

title: KEP-5963
description: KEP-5963：同一物理 GPU 的 MIG 与 vGPU 分区互斥共分配规则。
text:
KEP-5963 · 调度与绑定
同一物理 GPU 的 MIG 与 vGPU 分区不能混合共分配
                                                                                                                           Alpha
两个 compatibilityGroups 共享 counters；调度器只接受组交集非空的组合，并在绑定前完成拒绝。

  1 ResourceSlice：MIG + vGPU 两组                      2 Claim：请求同池 2 个逻辑 GPU           3 绑定后 status：选择两个 MIG

apiVersion: resource.k8s.io/v1                     apiVersion: resource.k8s.io/v1   status:
kind: ResourceSlice                                kind: ResourceClaim                allocation:
metadata:                                          metadata:                            nodeSelector:
  name: node-a-gpu-0                                 name: two-gpus                       nodeSelectorTerms:
spec:
                                                   spec:                                  - matchFields:
  driver: gpu.example.com
  pool: {name: node-a, generation: 4,                devices:                               - key: metadata.name
resourceSliceCount: 1}                                 requests:                              operator: In
  sharedCounters:                                      - name: gpu                            values: [node-a]
  - name: gpu-0-counters                                 exactly:                       devices:
    counters:                                              deviceClassName:               results:
      multiprocessors: {value: "100"}                         gpu.example.com             - request: gpu
  devices:                                                 count: 2                         driver: gpu.example.com
  - name: gpu-0-mig-1g-0                           # 场景中三个逻辑设备共享                            pool: node-a
    consumesCounters:
                                                   # gpu-0-counters；容量允许                    device: gpu-0-mig-1g-0
    - counterSet: gpu-0-counters
      counters: {multiprocessors: {value: "20"}}   # MIG+MIG 或 MIG+vGPU。                  - request: gpu
      compatibilityGroups: [mig]                                                            driver: gpu.example.com
  - name: gpu-0-mig-1g-1                                                                    pool: node-a
    consumesCounters:                                                                       device: gpu-0-mig-1g-1
    - counterSet: gpu-0-counters                                                    # {mig} ∩ {mig} = {mig} ✓
      counters: {multiprocessors: {value: "20"}}                                    # {mig} ∩ {vgpu} = ∅ → Filter 阶段拒绝
      compatibilityGroups: [mig]
  - name: gpu-0-vgpu-0
    consumesCounters:
    - counterSet: gpu-0-counters
      counters: {multiprocessors: {value: "50"}}
      compatibilityGroups: [vgpu]

                                                                                                                           v1.37 Alpha
  闭环结果         成功绑定的 status 只记录最终设备，不复制 compatibilityGroups；MIG+vGPU 即使 counters 容量足够也会在调               DRADeviceCompatibilityGroups +
               度阶段失败，不再拖到节点 prepare。                                                                          DRAPartitionableDevices

title: KEP-6080 附录
description: KEP-6080 附录：GPU/NIC 各自派生 `shared-numa-node`，再用 `matchAttribute` 实现共置。
text:
KEP-6080 · 跨驱动拓扑
Derived Attributes 在 Claim 内统一不同厂商的属性命名
GPU 写 numa、NIC 写 numaNode；每个 request 用 CEL 派生 shared-numa-node，再用 matchAttribute 共置。                                           Alpha



   1 不同 驱动、不同属性 schema                         2 每个 request 派生 统一属性                       3 status 记录同 NUMA 的设备

 apiVersion: resource.k8s.io/v1              spec:                                      status:
 kind: ResourceSlice
 metadata: {name: node-a-gpu}
                                               devices:                                   allocation:
 spec:                                           requests:                                  devices:
   driver: gpu.nvidia.com                        - name: gpu                                  results:
   pool: {name: node-a, generation: 1,             exactly:                                   - request: gpu
 resourceSliceCount: 1}
   nodeName: node-a                                  deviceClassName: gpu.example.com           driver: gpu.example.com
   devices:                                          derivedAttributes:                         pool: node-a
   - name: gpu-0                                     - name: shared-numa-node                   device: gpu-0
     basic:
       attributes:                                      expression: |                         - request: nic
         gpu.nvidia.com/numa: {int: 0}                    device.attributes[                    driver: nic.example.com
 ---                                                        "gpu.nvidia.com"].numa              pool: node-a
 apiVersion: resource.k8s.io/v1
 kind: ResourceSlice
                                                 - name: nic                                    device: nic-3
 metadata: {name: node-a-nic}                      exactly:                             ---
 spec:                                               deviceClassName: nic.example.com   # 派生值仅参与调度：
   driver: dra.net                                   derivedAttributes:                 # gpu-0 → shared-numa-node = 0
   pool: {name: node-a, generation: 1,
 resourceSliceCount: 1}                              - name: shared-numa-node           # nic-3 → shared-numa-node = 0
   nodeName: node-a                                     expression: |                                                （不选）
                                                                                        # nic-4 → shared-numa-node = 1
   devices:                                               device.attributes[
   - name: nic-3
     basic:                                                 "dra.net"].numaNode
       attributes:                               constraints:
         dra.net/numaNode: {int: 0}              - requests: [gpu, nic]
   - name: nic-4                                   matchAttribute: shared-numa-node
     basic:
       attributes:
         dra.net/numaNode: {int: 1}



   闭环结果           派生属性只在本次 allocation 计算中存在，不写回 ResourceSlice/Claim status；它解决跨厂商 schema 对齐，不                                  v1.37 Alpha
                  改变驱动的原始属性。                                                                          DRADerivedAttributes（Alpha，默认关闭）
